summary: Build ISO 14001:2026 EMS foundations with PECB training, practical examples, exercises, quizzes, and preparation for the Foundation exam.
audienceIntro: ISO 14001 Foundation is for people who support environmental management or need a working introduction to EMS requirements. It is suitable for foundation-level learners, including professionals who contribute to environmental performance and those exploring a career in environmental management.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course. To apply for the Certificate Holder in ISO 14001:2026 Foundation credential after passing the exam, you must sign the PECB Code of Ethics; no professional or EMS project experience is required.
